title: Solve GJ
tagline: Legacy: recompute the torsional stiffness GJ of an existing EI and Cross Section feature and write it back to its stored data and table.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: GJ used to be a separate step. EI and Cross Section now computes GJ itself with the same solver, so Solve GJ changes nothing on a current model. It is kept so older documents still regenerate.
useWhen: An older document still has it in the tree
slides.caption: GJ (orange) is already in every EI and Cross Section result.

slides.title: The dialog
params: One EI and Cross Section feature.
slides.note: GJ = 4 x sum(G x Iz) over the section's triangles, G = each body's Q66 (thin-plate Saint-Venant).

keys: GJ of every station in the feature's CrossSectionAnalysis data and table.
messages: The selected feature has no stored sections.

items.head: Fixed 2026-09-25
items.body: The recomputed GJ was written to a copy and lost; errors were swallowed. Both fixed.

items.head: Redundant
items.body: Safe to delete from new models.
